proposal: Require user-confirmed post-as-of account state and a completed latest-session market refresh before any live adjustment recommendation.
title: Current-state and market-freshness gate before live action
trigger: LKG state is accepted only through 2026-07-20 and A-share data is not confirmed current beyond that point.

proposal: Every simulation review must reconcile open-position unrealized contribution, closed-position or fee residual, cash and total account PnL without silently forcing equality.
title: Simulation account PnL bridge is mandatory
trigger: Open-position unrealized PnL differs from total account PnL because closed-position, fee or other residual effects exist.

proposal: Require explicit cost, tracking, liquidity, tax and execution comparison before consolidating duplicate index exposures; prohibit automatic consolidation.
title: Duplicate benchmark exposure requires controlled review
trigger: Two real-account ETFs track the S&P 500.

proposal: Block incremental simulation exposure while a no-add flag is active and require an append-only review decision before a hard-review deadline can be cleared.
title: No-add and hard-review flags are binding controls
trigger: Four simulation positions carry no-add controls and two positions carry hard-review requirements.

proposal: Require multiple independent observation windows, thesis validation, valuation, downside, portfolio fit and explicit user approval before any real-capital migration.
title: Positive simulation samples do not automatically migrate to real capital
trigger: Positive open-position contribution exists for multiple simulation names but does not establish persistent alpha or portfolio fit.

proposal: Evaluate triggers only against validated current quotes and route any met trigger to memo review rather than automatic Candidate Pool or portfolio admission.
title: Candidate price triggers require current quotes and no automatic membership change
trigger: Six Active Memo thresholds exist and none were met in the accepted 2026-07-20 snapshot.

proposal: Do not calculate candidate alpha or selection attribution without an approved entry baseline, benchmark, observation window and exposure state.
title: Candidate outcome attribution requires an approved entry baseline
trigger: Research graduation and Candidate Core membership do not provide an approved entry price or exposure start for every security.

proposal: Require multiple independent observations, failure classification, regression testing and human approval before applying any strategy-rule change.
title: No single period may mutate system rules
trigger: One portfolio snapshot or one security outcome is insufficient to establish a robust rule change.
